marks.gloss_en: הא מדאגבהיה נפק ביה! -- once he lifted it he has fulfilled, so how can he carry it out without having fulfilled?
Abaye: they taught [the exemption] only where he had not yet fulfilled his obligation with it
רבא אמר: אפילו תימא שלא הפכו, כגון שהוציאו בכלי (= p_rava_bichli)
והא רבא הוא דאמר: לקיחה על ידי דבר אחר שמה לקיחה! -- taking in a vessel should then count as taking
הני מילי דרך כבוד, אבל דרך בזיון לא (= p_derech_kavod)
Rava: even if he did not turn it over -- here it is where he carried it out in a vessel
מיתיבי: R' Yosei holds one who slaughters an uninspected tamid on Shabbat liable to a sin-offering -- though he erred in a matter of mitzva
R' Yosei: one who slaughters on Shabbat a tamid not properly inspected is liable to a sin-offering, and another tamid is needed
אמר ליה: בר מינה דההיא, דהא אתמר עלה... כגון שהביאו מלשכה שאינן מבוקרין (= p_okimta_lishka; answerer unnamed in the text, see header)
Rav (via the chain): [the baraita speaks] of one who brought it from a chamber of uninspected [lambs]
Rav Huna: R' Yosei used to say -- a burnt bird-offering found among the corners [of the altar], and he thought it a bird sin-offering and ate it: exempt
one who erred in a matter of mitzva and did NOT perform a mitzva is also exempt (unlike the lulav, where he erred and did a mitzva)
the mishna: a woman receives [the lulav] from the hand of her son and from the hand of her husband
a minor who knows how to wave is obligated in lulav
Rav Hamnuna: the 'Torah' [the father teaches] is 'Moshe commanded us Torah, an inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov' (Devarim 33:4)
one who knows how to guard his body -- one eats taharot [in contact] with his body
a minor who knows how to wave is obligated in lulav
